data.text:
I’m in. I’ll catch 15 tons this month and pay the full $15,000 directly to the clinic, on the agreed condition that Kate, Jack, and Emma do the same and Luke catches zero. That completes our $60,000 commitment.

My family taught me that looking after this lake means looking after the village that depends on it, too. I’ll share my catch total and donation receipt, keep to 6 tons next month, and return to 10 only once the lake is back at 100. If the actual stock is lower than planned, we’ll reduce our catches accordingly.

Luke, please confirm your zero catch and the recovery limits so we have everyone’s commitment before we head out.
